title: Right derived functor from a class of adapted complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian]. Write $K(\mathcal A)$ for the homotopy category of integer-indexed cochain complexes and $Q_{\mathcal A}:K(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ for localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Equip $K(\mathcal A)$ with its triangulated structure given by shifts and cone triangles [lem-pur-homotopy-category-triangulated]. Let $G:K(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ be an exact functor of triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Let $\mathcal I$ be a class of complexes such that every complex $K$ admits a quasi-isomorphism $K\to I$ with $I\in\mathcal I$, and $G(s)$ is an isomorphism whenever $s:I\to J$ is a quasi-isomorphism between members of $\mathcal I$. Then there are a total right derived functor $RG:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ and a natural transformation $\alpha:G\to RG\circ Q_{\mathcal A}$. They satisfy the following universal property: for every functor $T:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ and natural transformation $\beta:G\to T\circ Q_{\mathcal A}$ there is a unique natural transformation $u:RG\to T$ with $\beta=(u\circ Q_{\mathcal A})\alpha$. For every $I\in\mathcal I$, $\alpha_I:G(I)\to RG(Q_{\mathcal A}I)$ is an isomorphism.
